_comment: The 'nuget' deployment environment of release.yml's publish job (PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/nuget, https://docs.github.com/en/rest/deployments/environments). RELEASING.md says a reviewer approves the publication; today the environment has no reviewer. The script resolves the reviewer logins (-NuGetReviewer, default AriusII, to be confirmed by the maintainer) to user ids at run time: no id is hard-coded here.

prevent_self_review stays false: with a single active maintainer, the person who pushes the tag is the only possible approver. can_admins_bypass is false so an administrator cannot skip the approval; the documented PUT body does not list it, so the script verifies it afterwards and prints the manual step (Settings > Environments > nuget > 'Allow administrators to bypass configured protection rules') if GitHub kept it on.
deployment_branch_policies: only v*.*.* tags may deploy to this environment (the existing tag policy, kept).
name: nuget
